history.event: Claude refinement: 26 line(s) suggested — Most corrections restore garbled words in the formulas of a notarial-style ricordo (vendite, apparisce carte, restituire, liberamente, the names Lisabetta, Andrea and Gianetta, the ß = ser abbreviation), as well as the year 1455 (not 1456) in l12 and 1494 (not 1444) in l26. | layout: l1: marginal title opposite l2; it probably belongs before the entry; l27: marginal sum ƒ .14 sits beside l15/l16; it matches the fiorini .14 of l18; l23: a closing bracket/flourish at the far right lies outside the box; l24: the large bracket-like flourish at the start lies partly outside the box | doubts: l1: the marginal title is hard to read at this resolution; 'dela casa da terranuova' is a guess from the context; l2/l22: the wife's name reads as gianetta or giovannetta; l22 has a small abbreviated word (m̄a?) before it; l4: the word after chome (edeto? = è detto) is unclear; l9/l17: 'all' or 'att' (a lire) cannot be told apart in the image; l17: the signs after 'att 4' (ß ꝓƒ?) are unclear; l14: the struck-through word after 'di' is illegible; l15: the last word (alpio / a piero?) runs into 'vano' at the start of l16 (a Piero di Giovano?); Throughout: I kept Kraken's ꝓ for per/par, although the hand writes p with a crossed descender (ꝑ); Laura should decide which character to use
